connector.registryDescription: Find & cut horizontal and vertical video clips (Shorts/Reels), transcribe & summarize. Pay per job.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.weftly.ai over streamable HTTP. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.weftly, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
